screenshots.caption: All 11 rows show process, engagement direction, reach and remaining material. Drilling is row 4; stock-end cleanup is row 7; finishing passes are rows 8–11.

screenshots.title: Import a checkpoint without training again
screenshots.caption: The loaded checkpoint is now fresh-random-b-checkpoint.json. The previous result still names Initial model and retains its original model identity until inference is run again.

screenshots.caption: B completes in 24 cuts with 0 mm³ sampled residual. Model identity used for this result exposes the canonical checkpoint hash and Download inferred sequence model.

screenshots.title: B actions 1–14
screenshots.caption: The imported policy starts with facing toward +axis at 5 mm reach. It differs from Initial outside turning at 40 mm. These are observed decisions, without an efficiency claim.

screenshots.title: B remaining actions and finishing passes
screenshots.caption: Rows 12–24 overlap the preceding capture. Drilling is row 17, stock-end cleanup row 20 and the four finishing passes are rows 21–24. The final residual is zero.

screenshots.title: Read-only replay at 12 / 24 events

screenshots.title: Linked views at the same replay event

screenshots.title: Replay through completion
screenshots.caption: At 24 / 24 events the sampled residual is zero. The replay checks all 12 listed features and records the nine finishing checks.
